about: The Haftarah from the Prophets calls Israel the children of “Abraham my friend.” God promises, “Do not be afraid, for I am with you.” The reading from the Apostles talks about Abraham’s circumcision and shows that he trusted God, and God counted his faith as righteousness. That makes Abraham the father of everyone who believes.
prompts: What verse spoke to you most today and why?
Did you learn something you need to do in your life?
